exceptions.justification: TOOLKIT.md is added by this very pull request, so it does not exist on the default branch the link points at until the pull request merges.
exceptions.ruleBroken: Docs (links): every external link must be reachable.
exceptions.attempted: Linking the file by relative path instead; the link is deliberately absolute because the text is copied into other repositories' READMEs.
exceptions.constraint: An absolute GitHub link to a new file cannot resolve before the file is on the default branch.
exceptions.whyPreferable: A one-off record that expires beats a relative link that would be wrong everywhere the paragraph is reused.
exceptions.residualRisk: None: if the link is still dead after the merge, the record has expired and the check fails again.
